episodes.title: Born Into a Cult: “I Didn’t Know Who I Was”
episodes.description:
Gilli describes himself as a cult survivor. Born into the Plymouth Brethren Christian Church (PBCC), he talks about growing up inside a high-control religious group, leaving the PBCC, religious trauma, family separation and the reality of rebuilding a life outside everything he had ever known.

Gilli is also a male survivor of childhood sexual abuse. He talks openly about why male victims of sexual abuse can struggle to understand what has happened to them, including the confusion caused by the body’s physical response to abuse and why that response does not mean consent or responsibility.

We talk about the rules he grew up with, relationships and marriage, separation from the outside world, coercive control, shunning, losing contact with family, suicide attempts, therapy, trauma, flashbacks and trying to work out who he really is after leaving.

Why don’t people just leave? Gilli explains why, when you have been born into one world and taught to fear what exists outside it, leaving is nowhere near that simple.

If Netflix’s Unchosen prompted you to search for real-life experiences of cults, closed religious communities or high-control religious groups, this is Gilli’s personal experience. No official connection between the PBCC and Unchosen is being claimed.

⚠️ CONTENT WARNING: This episode discusses childhood sexual abuse, suicide attempts, coercive control and family separation.

UK SUPPORT

https://247sexualabusesupport.org.uk/

NAPAC – support for adult survivors of childhood abuse:
Call 0808 801 0331
https://napac.org.uk/calling-our-support-line/

If you are in immediate danger, call 999 or go to your nearest A&E.

🎙️ You Can Do Hard Things with Jenny Melling
Real conversations about survival, resilience and rebuilding.

Until then, remember: life can be pretty shit sometimes, but you’ve got this. You can do hard things.
